summary: Verified white-base logo bug fix on preview. Header logo and admin ImageField preview both use bg-black (computed rgb(0, 0, 0)) with the customer-provided logo URL. No white base anywhere behind logo images. Only remaining bg-white in codebase is Gallery close button (bg-white/10 translucent, acceptable).

issues: Date of Birth field uses the browser default date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a styled shadcn Calendar/Popover — inconsistent with dark theme

action_items: Redeploy to production so the fixed build reaches end user (dev/preview verified correct).
(Optional) Replace browser-native <input type=date> in booking modal with shadcn Calendar/Popover to match dark theme.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx logo wrapper correctly uses bg-black with overflow-hidden + scale-150 origin-top to crop the tall 1986x2000 asset to the icon area — verified visually.
ImageField.jsx preview img correctly uses bg-black class; computed style confirms rgb(0,0,0).
No stray bg-white found behind any logo image; only Gallery close button uses bg-white/10 (translucent overlay, expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 confirmed white-base logo bug is fixed on the preview environment. GET /api/content returns clinic.logo = customer-assets URL. Header (data-testid=header-logo) inner span computed bg = rgb(0,0,0) with class bg-black; img.src exact match. Admin Clinic Info tab preview img[alt=preview] computed bg = rgb(0,0,0) with class bg-black; src matches. Booking modal opens correctly via header-book-btn. User was seeing PRODUCTION (old build) — redeploy is expected to resolve.
rca of the issue: Root cause: an older DB record + old header/admin styling used bg-white behind the logo image (which historically was the transparent dentistree.me tooth logo). Fixes applied in earlier iterations: (a) DEFAULT_CLINIC.logo set to the new customer-assets URL, (b) startup migration replaces OLD_LOGO_URLS in existing DB documents, (c) Header.jsx wrapping span switched to bg-black with scale-150 origin-top to crop the tall webp asset to the icon area, (d) ImageField.jsx preview thumbnail changed from bg-white to bg-black. Verification on preview environment shows all three surfaces (public header, admin preview, API payload) are correct. User-visible white base likely comes from stale production build — redeploy required.
